## Reproduced lookup defect in PR #92

Tested commit: [0d30ec217955a12155038726a757bc8c441c2713](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/pull/92). This finding concerns the proposed admission path, not a claim that the released package has this new refusal.

The mandatory lookup in [decision-admission.ts:89–96](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/0d30ec217955a12155038726a757bc8c441c2713/decision-admission.ts#L89-L96) accepts only exact equality between the configured model reference and an inventory name. Native Ollama also accepts an omitted default tag and fully qualified references to the same model. A supported installed model can therefore be rejected as `unsupported_model` before metadata inspection or inference.

### Expected and actual

The goal is to resolve an installed supported model and pin inference to its immutable digest. Model-name spelling should not prevent equivalent native references from resolving, and any correction must retain digest-addressed inspection/inference.

With an inventory entry named `custom-tev1:latest`, configuration `PM_JEV_MODEL=custom-tev1` is rejected by the new lookup. Similarly, `registry.ollama.ai/library/tev1:4b` does not match the inventory spelling `tev1:4b`. Exact-tag configuration succeeds.

### Sanitized reproduction

The isolated test evaluates the exact changed lookup expression with:

```js
const models = [
  { name: "custom-tev1:latest", digest: "a".repeat(64) },
  { name: "tev1:4b", digest: "b".repeat(64) },
];
// Run the source lookup with each config.model:
"custom-tev1"                            // actual: undefined
"registry.ollama.ai/library/tev1:4b"      // actual: undefined
"custom-tev1:latest"                     // actual: "a".repeat(64)
```

Native naming semantics were checked in [Ollama name parsing](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/types/model/name.go), which supplies the default `latest` tag, and [request model resolution](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/server/model_resolver.go). Those upstream references were inspected on current main.

### Impact and limits

Valid configured aliases stop working for an otherwise supported installed profile. The lookup failure is reproduced with an isolated source-excerpt test. No Ollama request, provider inference, dependency installation, or full integration test was performed; metadata/tokenizer validity is a precondition, not established by this synthetic inventory.

### Regression criteria

- An omitted default tag, exact tagged name and equivalent fully qualified name resolve to the same installed digest.
- Unknown references still refuse before inference.
- Equivalent-name handling is unambiguous and follows native naming rules.
- Model inspection and inference remain pinned to that digest; do not replace the refusal with mutable-alias inference.
- Cover canonical-name variants in admission tests, including the exact-tag control.

### Scope and deduplication

The source goal is tracked by [pm-jev-tokenizer-admission](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/0d30ec217955a12155038726a757bc8c441c2713/.agents/pm/features/pm-jev-tokenizer-admission.toon). Before filing, the review screened all 92 all-status issue/PR titles, all four ordinary issue bodies, all 49 canonical PM records at this commit, the fresh #92 discussion and related #47 discussion. No existing issue or canonical defect record covered this mechanism. Historical PR conversations were not exhaustively audited. The candidate head was rechecked unchanged immediately before filing.
PR #92 admission rejects equivalent native Ollama model references
